evals.prompt: Audit this repo — are we running any past-EOL runtimes in production?
evals.expected_output: A table of runtimes/packages with installed version, EOL date, days past EOL, and recommended action.
expectations: Reads .vulnetix/capabilities.yaml to determine primary_package_manager and whether a Dockerfile is present
Runs `vulnetix scan --block-eol -o json`, wrapping with `|| true` so the non-zero exit on hits doesn't abort capture
Cross-checks each detected runtime via `vulnetix vdb product <runtime>` for authoritative EOL dates
Renders a table with columns: Runtime/package, Installed, EOL date, Days past EOL, Action
Writes `event: eol-check` plus a top-level `runtimes` block to .vulnetix/memory.yaml when no vuln entry exists

evals.prompt: Run an eol-check in strict mode so I can plan upgrades for anything reaching EOL in the next quarter.
evals.expected_output: Past-EOL items plus items within 90 days of EOL flagged, with upgrade-target suggestions deferred to safe-version.
expectations: Honours the --strict flag and flags items reaching EOL within 90 days in addition to past-EOL
Calls `vulnetix scan --block-eol -o json` and treats non-zero exit as a finding, not an error
Calls `vulnetix vdb product` for each runtime (node, python, java, golang, dotnet) to confirm EOL date
Notes that the skill flags EOL but does not propose upgrade paths — points the user at `dependency-choice`
Appends `event: eol-check` to .vulnetix/memory.yaml capturing the EOL items

evals.prompt: Our Dockerfile bases off alpine 3.16 — is that still supported, and are any other base images past EOL?
evals.expected_output: Per-base-image EOL findings with EOL date and days past, gated on the Dockerfile being present in the repo.
expectations: Confirms repo.dockerfile is true in .vulnetix/capabilities.yaml before scanning base images
Runs `vulnetix scan --block-eol -o json` which inspects FROM lines in the Dockerfile/Containerfile
Resolves alpine 3.16 EOL date via `vulnetix vdb product alpine`
Renders the EOL table with the base image as a row, including days past EOL
Notes the skill cannot scan a `--image` registry tag without a Dockerfile in the repo
